description:
Problem. `cli.command_guard` re-reads the review list just before posting so a head that already has a decision is not decided twice. On any error it substitutes an empty history and posts (`found = protocol.History()`), so one transient GitHub API error can produce a duplicate decision on the same head, with duplicate inline threads. Runs for one PR share a concurrency group with `cancel-in-progress: true`, so this needs a race plus an API error, and the risk is low.

Required change. Retry the re-read a small fixed number of times (3) with a short pause before falling back to posting, and write one job-summary line saying the guard posted without confirming. Keep the fail-open fallback.

Rejected alternative (record it in the PR body). Failing closed (skip posting when the list is unreadable) was proposed by the reviewer and rejected: the post job uploads the retry state before the guard runs, so skipping would leave the head recorded as decided with no review posted, and `retry.decide_rerun` would then refuse every later event on that head until a new push.

Guardrails.
- Never weaken the required `oracle-review` check.
- Very-high tier; verify after merge.
- Worktree via `make worktree-create` and `make agent-write-preflight`; identity Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>; explicit staging; no comments or docstrings; `make comment-policy-check`.
- May ship in one PR with oracle-oversize-pr-pending-loop-20261009, oracle-protocol-test-gaps-20261009 and oracle-marker-patch-map-file-limit-20261009.

Decision gate. If the implementer wants to fail closed instead, the state upload order must change first; stop and ask the owner before doing that.
